row.evidence: Bullhorn's knowledge base documents SAML SSO only, with SSO "enabled or disabled for each individual user"; users are created by an admin copying an existing user in Admin > Users, and no SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre, REST API docs or pricing page.
row.notes: New row. Researched the Bullhorn ATS & CRM (Novo) product; Bullhorn Recruitment Cloud (built on Salesforce) and other Bullhorn products were not researched. No SCIM: SAML SSO (Okta, Entra ID, AD FS, Google, OneLogin) is configured per user, and users are created and disabled manually by admins (disabling frees the licence). The Okta OIN app is SAML/SWA sign-on only. The REST API documents PUT/POST /services/CorporateUser to add or update users 'with appropriate access', but the API is contract-gated (partners pay an annual platform fee; customer API keys come from Bullhorn), and no IdP connector uses it, so api_provisioning stays false. Pricing page lists Starter $99 and Core $165 per user/month (billing basis not stated); Pro, Max and the larger-agency plans are Talk to sales. The pricing page does not say which plan includes SSO.

plans.name: Front Office Growth / Front Office Enterprise / Bullhorn One

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint found; scim.available is false by absence (searched list). Manual admin disable 'frees up their licence'.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 access token, then a REST login call returns a BhRestToken session token and the base URL.

capabilities.notes: The entity reference calls CorporateUser read-only via /entity, but the CorporateUser service adds or updates users 'with appropriate access'. CorporateUser has an 'enabled' field (may log in), but disabling via the API is not explicitly documented.

endpoints.purpose: Get users (generic entity GET with entityType CorporateUser)
Add a delegate for a user

rate_limits.text: Integration partners: 200,000 API calls per month included in the annual platform fee, overage charges above that.

limitations.text: API access is contract-gated: technology vendors must contract for API access, customers will not get an API key to hand to an uncontracted vendor, and third-party connector/middleware companies are not permitted.
Adding users through the API may incur additional user fees.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML and SWA only (no SCIM or provisioning checked); Bullhorn's own Okta guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app.

entra.notes: Bullhorn's guide uses an Entra App registration; no Microsoft Learn gallery tutorial found.

fallbacks.notes: SSO is switched on per existing user; no JIT account creation is documented, so jit is recorded false on the strength of the per-user enablement step.
